name: Opti-STRK
description: The Opti-STRK was a model of battle droid with red and black plating and a black photoreceptor. A type of monster droid, Opti-STRK consisted of a BB-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton with the two arms and two legs of a Baktoid Combat Automata B2-series super battle droid. Blueprints for the droid were sold by a group of Jawas on the planet Tatooine who worked out of the Sandcrawler Shop beside the Junkers Cantina. A default design Opti-STRK blueprint cost 37,000,000 credits, a golden design cost 148,000,000 credits, a diamond-colored version cost 296,000,000 credits, and a rainbow-colored design cost 592,000,000 credits.
